I had a nice experience shopping at Pet Paradise in Harajuku. The items are adorable, well-made, and there’s a great selection for pet lovers.

That said, I feel the overall experience could be even better with a slightly warmer customer service approach. A simple SMILE or a bit more friendliness from the staff would make the visit feel more welcoming and memorable 😊
I visited both branches and bought a few outfits for my dog. Although there are plenty of options for small breeds, selections were quite limited for my Golden Retriever.
Very nice shop, although a bit small, but you can find a variety of sweaters and outfits for dogs.

Pet Paradise is a brand I frequently use, but I had a very unpleasant experience at the checkout counter of their Harajuku store today.

When paying, I was checking the size of the item I intended to purchase to make sure it was suitable for my pet.

I clearly stated, "I'd like to purchase this," but despite me being in line, they processed the customer behind me first, completely ignoring my request.

Even when I said, "I'd like to pay," they didn't respond.

Furthermore, when another staff member inquired about the situation, the staff member in charge gave a dismissive "I don't know."

To top it all off, as I was leaving, I overheard the cashier with yellow hair say, "This one's a pain."

As a service worker and as a customer, I found this extremely rude and unacceptable.

I've always had a good impression of the brand, so this experience is very disappointing.

I strongly urge the Harajuku store to immediately improve their customer service and respect for customers.

The prices are ridiculously high, catering to inbound tourists, and the staff's attitude is terrible. The store is so narrow you can't get through, yet the staff don't move out of the way. It's not that they can't move, but rather that they have no intention of doing so. The cashier's service was also unpleasant. I decided it wasn't worth going all the way to Harajuku just to buy something there.

I never want to go there again.

Located in the incredibly crowded Harajuku area, it's less than a 10-minute walk from the station (if there's no traffic). Every staff member is extremely attentive; if they see a customer carrying a lot of items, they'll proactively help them get a basket at the door. They also seem very familiar with each product.

The attentive and enthusiastic service, coupled with a friendly attitude, and the good quality of the goods!

We came here looking for an outfit for our pet but it was so expensive! This is on the busiest street in Harajuku and honestly, walking through the crowds of tourists and seeing all these animal cafes (which are highly abusive and immoral) made me feel icky even before getting into this store. Avoid if you can!

The shop assistants were very friendly. If you were unsure about the size of the dog clothes, they would use plush dog models to demonstrate.

So many cute things for the dog parents. I got my dog a very cute harness with strawberry bear pouch. Our biggest fear was our dog wasn’t going to fit the harness. However, one of the clerks asked us about the breed and weight of our dog, then she brought out mannique sized doggy to simulate sizing. It was honestly so nice ans reassuring.
If you are a doggy parent traveling abroad, definitely worth it to check this place out.
And we got a teddy bear outfit ☺️

To thank them,  I thought I'd share a picture of Meowser with her new harness.
